source: Math grade 3, chapter 1 «الگوها», lesson «الگوهای متقارن» (book p. 19). Card v1.0 (source docx L1920: half of the decorative bed is ready, the player completes the other side; Mirror Drag, snap to the mirrored coordinate; wrong = a flower near but not symmetric; SYM-M01 only equalises the number of flowers, SYM-M02 ignores the distance to the axis; H1 «به خط وسط باغچه دقت کن.», H2 the symmetry line appears, H3 the distance of one flower to the axis is shown; assets PROP_GARDEN_BED, PROP_FLOWER_A/B/C, PROP_SYMMETRY_STONE, PROP_CENTER_LINE; Transfer: the Library window) + card v1.1 (L2964: soft grid snap; select piece → observe the axis → drag → snap; wrong = the piece does not stay and a Ghost Mirror shows; misconception: symmetry taken as «same shape» without the position relative to the axis; H1 «محور را پیدا کن.», H2 distance of the piece to the axis, H3 ghost location; PROP_GARDEN_TILE, PROP_SYMMETRY_AXIS, PROP_MIRROR_GHOST; tile_snap, ghost_appear, garden_bloom, success_wave; ceramic click, soft garden chime; analytics axis_identified, tile_moved, tile_error, mirror_preview, solved; mastery = symmetry completed on two axes / a different design; Transfer: the workshop window with metal parts). Plan 12 §1 row 5, plan 04 MATH-05.

stages.objective_fa: گل‌ها را آن طرفِ خط وسط، مثل آینه بکار.

phases.objective_fa: گل‌ها را آن طرفِ خط وسط، مثل آینه بکار.

hints.animation: LUMI flies slowly along the centre line of the bed, back to front; the pebbles twinkle one after another
the brass symmetry axis rises on the centre line (PROP_SYMMETRY_AXIS) and one flower whose mirror is missing shows its distance to the axis as glowing step dots (card v1.0 H2 + v1.1 H2)
the same number of step dots continue on the other side of the axis and end in a Ghost Mirror of that flower (card v1.0 H3 + v1.1 H3)

stages.objective_fa: کاشی‌ها را مثل آینه بچین؛ اول آن طرفِ خط عمودی، بعد پایینِ خط افقی.

phases.objective_fa: کاشی‌ها را آن طرفِ خط عمودی، مثل آینه بچین.
حالا کاشی‌ها را پایینِ خط افقی، مثل آینه بچین.

hints.animation: LUMI flies along the active axis of the mosaic frame
the axis glows and one tile shows its distance to the axis as step dots
the step dots continue across the axis and end in a ghost tile

misconceptions.description: Only makes the number of flowers equal on both sides; the flower is put somewhere on the empty half without matching a flower of the other half (card v1.0).
Right row and right flower, but the distance to the axis is not kept (card v1.0).
Copies the half by sliding it across (same shape, same order) instead of reflecting it: «same shape» without the position relative to the axis (card v1.1 misconception; team code, plan 04).

mastery.note: card v1.1 mastery: symmetry completed on two axes / a different design → the practice mosaic (vertical then horizontal axis). Levels 4-5 need the Transfer (Library window, variant: workshop window with metal parts) — outside this room.

audio.on_place: flower: soft soil pat + soft garden chime; tile: ceramic click (tile_snap)
audio.on_wrong: soft wobble, no punishment; Ghost Mirror shimmer (ghost_appear)
